description: Adding a number to a null number is an error
notes: The spec doesn't say what arithmetic operators do with a null operand. A typed null avoids the question of whether the null keyword, a value of the dynamic pseudo-type, makes the result unknown. hashicorp/hcl reports an error because go-cty's AddFunc (cty/function/stdlib/number.go) doesn't accept null arguments, which Function.Call checks (cty/function/function.go).
